topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Finding out that my partner has been pouring their thoughts and emotions into a novel about me is like uncovering a hidden garden of our shared experiences. Each word, each sentence, is a seed they've planted, nurtured with the hope that it would grow into something beautiful and meaningful. It’s a gift, really, to be seen so deeply, to have someone articulate the intricate details of our life together. I can't wait to delve into the pages, to trace the lines of our story through their eyes. It’s a promise of many quiet evenings spent reading, discussing, and growing closer, chapter by chapter.
